All tests pass. The implementation in `bottle_song.go`:

- **`Recite(startBottles, takeDown)`** — loops from `startBottles` down, appending a verse per bottle, with a blank line (`""`) inserted *between* verses (never after the last one).
- **`verse(n)`** — builds the four lines; uses `bottleSuffix(n)` to switch between "bottle" (singular, n==1) and "bottles".
- **`bottleWord(n)`** — maps 0–10 to words (`no`, `one`, …, `ten`); the first two lines capitalize via `strings.Title`, while the "There'll be …" line stays lowercase.
